svg.title: Hook tip drop
svg.desc: This dial changes no shape. Only acts when size is Custom. Changes no shape: the hook slot's mouth already opens through the cord end (the body ends at Y = 0), so sagging the mouth farther below that edge cuts only air; measured at 1.98, 4 and 0.
